mark.note: Office note · only your colleagues read it
mark.reply: Email to {party} · the people in To and Cc read it

placeholder.note: Write an office note for your colleagues · @ mentions a colleague
placeholder.portal: Write to {party}: they read it in their portal

live.note: Office note — only your colleagues read it
live.portal: In the portal only — {party} reads this in their portal, no e-mail

held.offline: You are offline · your text stays on this device
held.amount: Fix the amount first: a number, at most two decimals
held.amountFloor: An amount stays in the office: untick “For the floor” or take the amount off
held.floorPrice: Held: “{found}” looks like a price, and the floor never sees money. Take it out, or write it as an office note’s amount

box.closed: Closed by {who}, {date}. The customer cannot write here.
box.closedPlain: This thread is closed. The customer cannot write here.
box.noRight: You can read this thread; writing in it needs another role.
box.noParty: This record has no customer: notes only.

prospect.line: {party} is a prospect, not a customer yet.

switch.mentions: Mentions stay in office notes: taken out of this message: {names}.
switch.amount: An amount stays on office notes: taken off this message.
switch.correction: A correction goes the way its message went: this is a new message now, not a correction.
switch.numbers: The customer reads its own numbers, never the office’s: changed in this message: {numbers}.

floor.label: For the floor
floor.on: The tablets of {record} show it: no prices, the first {limit} characters, for 14 days, no file, no name. Nobody records who read it.
floor.off: Off: only the office reads this note.
floor.long: The tablet shows the first {limit} characters.
floor.locked: The note you correct is on the tablets: the correction goes there too.

drop.note: Drop the files to add them to this office note (office only)
drop.reply: Drop the files to send them to {party}
drop.portal: Drop the files to share them with {party} in this message

portal.line: {party} reads it in their portal. No e-mail is sent: their mail setting decides when they hear of it (as it happens, unless they changed it).

correcting.note: Correcting your office note of {time}: the old one stays and says “Corrected below”
correcting.reply: Correcting your mail of {time}: whoever got it gets the correction
correcting.portal: Correcting your message of {time} in {party}’s portal

link.dropReply: Not a reply to that message any more
